_comment: Rules for classifying an OpenSky flight as an Airbus test / production / customer-acceptance / Beluga-shuttle flight at TLS or XFW. A flight matches if ANY registration prefix OR ANY callsign prefix matches. Sources: Flightradar24 'Where Airplanes are Born' blog (AIB callsign block) and 'The Airbus Beluga ST: A Whale of a Story' blog (Beluga registrations/callsigns); standard F-W provisional-registration convention used by Airbus for all in-pipeline airframes (own test fleet AND customer aircraft prior to handover); D-AV/D-AX/D-AZ sub-blocks used at Hamburg-Finkenwerder for the equivalent pre-delivery test registration on A320-family aircraft, confirmed against real jetphotos.com/aussieairliners.org test-flight records -- deliberately not the bare 'D-A' prefix, which would also match ordinary in-service German-registered aircraft.

registration_prefixes.label: French provisional/test registration
registration_prefixes.notes: Standard Airbus convention at Toulouse. Covers Airbus's own long-term development airframes (e.g. F-WWOW, F-WXLD) AND every customer aircraft still in flight test / acceptance before its permanent registration is applied. This is the broadest and most reliable single marker.

registration_prefixes.label: Beluga ST (original) registration block
registration_prefixes.notes: The five original A300-600ST Belugas: F-GSTA, F-GSTB, F-GSTC, F-GSTD, F-GSTF. These are permanently-registered Airbus-owned aircraft, not provisional F-W registrations, so they need this separate rule -- the F-W rule alone does not catch them.

registration_prefixes.label: BelugaXL registration block
registration_prefixes.notes: The six BelugaXL (A330-743L) aircraft, F-GXLG to F-GXLO (F-GXLO was the sixth and last delivered). Same rationale as F-GST -- permanently registered, not F-W.

registration_prefixes.label: German pre-delivery test registration (Hamburg-Finkenwerder), A320-family block
registration_prefixes.notes: The German equivalent of F-W: a temporary registration worn during test/acceptance flights at Hamburg before the aircraft is re-registered to its customer. Confirmed against multiple real Finkenwerder test flights (e.g. D-AVVB/IndiGo, D-AVXZ/Air New Zealand), each also carrying an AIB callsign. Deliberately NOT the bare 'D-A' prefix -- that covers the whole German civil register, including permanently-registered in-service aircraft (e.g. Lufthansa's D-AIPA, Condor's D-ANMZ), which would be a false-positive flood.

registration_prefixes.label: German pre-delivery test registration (Hamburg-Finkenwerder)
registration_prefixes.notes: Same rationale and sub-block as D-AV; confirmed against real examples (e.g. D-AXAR, D-AXAD).

registration_prefixes.label: German pre-delivery test registration (Hamburg-Finkenwerder)
registration_prefixes.notes: Same rationale and sub-block as D-AV; confirmed against real examples (e.g. D-AZAE, D-AZAQ).

callsign_prefixes.label: Airbus Industrie callsign
callsign_prefixes.notes: ATC callsign block used for Airbus-operated test, ferry, and delivery flights, independent of the aircraft's registration. Cross-check against registration_prefixes; a flight matching either counts.

callsign_prefixes.label: Airbus Transport International / Beluga callsign
callsign_prefixes.notes: ICAO designator BGA (telephony: BELOUGA) is used by Airbus Transport International. It covers the Airbus oversized-cargo shuttle operation and is a primary marker for Beluga flights.

callsign_prefixes.label: Airbus Beluga Transport / Beluga Cargo callsign
callsign_prefixes.notes: ICAO designator BCO (telephony: BELUGA CARGO) belongs to Airbus Beluga Transport. Including it ensures Beluga operations using this operator designator are not missed.

supporting_callsigns.label: Air France (occasionally used for A350/A320 delivery ferry legs)
supporting_callsigns.notes: Not used for primary classification -- informational only, high false-positive rate.

known_test_fleet_examples.role: Real Hamburg-Finkenwerder pre-delivery test example (2025): built for Air New Zealand, test-flown as AIB593A/B and AIB913C, delivered as ZK-NNI

known_beluga_fleet.role: Beluga #1 -- retired April 2021, no longer flying
BelugaXL #1 -- test airframe; entered service May 2024

exclusions.notes: Flights are scoped to departures/arrivals at TLS (LFBO) and XFW (EDHI) only. A matching registration or callsign seen elsewhere is not included -- this keeps the two-site comparison clean and matches the credit-budget constraints of the OpenSky API (departures+arrivals queries are per-airport).
